import sys

MOD = 1000000007

for line in sys.stdin:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    p_str, k_str = line.strip().split()
    p, k = int(p_str), int(k_str)
    if k == 0:
        l = p - 1
    elif k == 1:
        l = p
    else:
        l = -1
    ans = 1
    if l == -1:
        t = 1
        v = k
        while v != 1:
            v = (v * k) % p
            t += 1
        l = p // t
    for _ in range(l):
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    print(ans)
